headline: Non-executive director acquires 50,000 units on market
summary: A non-executive director purchased 50,000 units at $2.18 per unit, increasing their total holding to 410,000 units. This is a routine director interest notice.

headline: $85m placement at 9.5% discount to fund $120m clinic acquisition
summary: Coralwave raises $85m at $1.42/share to acquire Northshore Clinics for $120m. Acquisition expected EPS accretive in first full year, but placement discount dilutes existing holders.

headline: Pit wall failure cuts FY27 copper guidance, raises costs
summary: Kestrel mine haul road closed for eight weeks due to pit wall failure. FY27 copper production guidance lowered to 180-195kt and AISC increases 12% to A$4.85/lb.

headline: Half-year results show 31% revenue growth and first positive cash flow
summary: Quokka Software reported strong half-year results with 31% revenue growth and first positive operating cash flow. ARR reached $112m. Full-year guidance remains unchanged, indicating confidence in continued performance.

headline: CEO resigns effective 31 January 2027
summary: CEO resigns to pursue other opportunities. Board searching for successor; CFO to act as interim CEO if needed.

headline: All AGM resolutions passed on a poll
summary: Wattle Energy confirms all resolutions at its Annual General Meeting were passed by shareholders. This is a routine governance outcome with no unexpected developments.
